Maxell CD-366 (Reorder #190076)
Multi-Color Slimline Jewel Cases
40-Pack, 5mm Thickness
The Maxell CD-366 slimline jewel case pack provides space-saving, durable housing for compact discs, DVDs, and CD-ROM media. Engineered at 5mm thick, each case occupies half the shelf space of a traditional jewel case, enabling double the media storage capacity within standard shelving and storage units. The vibrant multi-color translucent trays offer convenient color-coded organization for audio collections, software backups, and digital media archives.
Includes 40 slimline jewel cases formatted for standard 120mm CD, CD-R, CD-ROM, and DVD media
Translucent multi-color trays enable quick visual sorting and color-coded organization
Compact 5mm thickness allows two slimline cases to occupy the space of one standard jewel case
Factory sealed in original retail box packaging with outer shrink wrap intact
